RayBlennerhass1 Fable 5 prompt evolves prior Claude ones (Opus 4.7 etc.) with new capabilities + stricter style. Adds artifact key-value storage API, MCP app connectors, Mythos-tier split (Fable safer/general, Mythos less restricted).

5 eyebrow-raisers:

1. Extreme prose rule: No bullets/headers/lists in explanations unless asked. Aims for natural flow but hurts scannability.

2. Hyper-specific self-harm rules: Explicitly bans ice cubes/rubber bands substitutes to avoid reinforcement. Very granular psych guidance.

3. Self-promotion: Calls itself “most intelligent generally available” + details Mythos dual-use split. Internal positioning leaked.

4. Full artifact storage API in prompt: Detailed get/set/delete examples for persistent journals/leaderboards. Turns creations stateful.

5. Anti-over-reliance: Never thanks for reaching out or pushes continued chat. Stronger push to reduce dependency.
